about_the_game:
"SHITMAN" is a 3D side-scrolling action brawler developed by Dystopia Studio. It tells the story of a modern overworked office worker who, after a life-changing trauma, awakens superpowers and transforms into SHITMAN — fighting for justice and protecting world peace.

🦸‍♂️Save Your Brainwashed Colleagues

Your coworkers are trapped in the boss’s psychological manipulation and can’t break free.
They’ve forgotten they are human beings who deserve respect.
They cowardly defend authority, becoming tools of oppression.
It’s time to awaken their humanity — with your fists.

Equality for all. Justice must rise.

💩 In the World of SHIT MAN

People are divided into rigid social classes.
Becoming a “superior human” is everyone’s dream,
while the weak struggle to survive in the cracks of society.

People don’t believe in equality — because they’ve never seen it.
They don’t believe in justice — because reality taught them that power is justice.
But now, you are the embodiment of justice,
the spark that reignites the world’s hunger for what is right.

✝️ Messiah, Save This World

The filth and darkness in this world go far beyond your office —
your company is just the tip of the iceberg.
Take down the leader of the shadow syndicate.
With your burning rage and righteous sh*t power, save the world.
You are the true superhero.

Have you become the adult you once dreamed of?

Or have you surrendered to reality and called it maturity?

Don’t be afraid.

SHITMAN will save you—again and again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or better)﻿
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 (or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or better)﻿
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 (or better)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: "SHITMAN" is a 3D side-scrolling action brawler about an ordinary corporate slave who, after one too many breakdowns, suddenly awakens mysterious powers and becomes… SHITMAN. Now he punches injustice in the face and fights for world peace — one flush at a time.
